thread:
maria_cs: Heads-up — Cedarbridge renewal hits EOW. They accepted the 12‑month term, but procurement is pushing a 9‑month PO and different billing entity. Risk: legal will need to review the amended SOW and finance needs vendor code before we can invoice. can anyone help triage? :eyes:
sam_ae: looping in Olivia + Jason. customer is asking for pricing to stay the same despite switching to 9mo PO?

bryan_cedarbridge: correct — procurement can only issue a 9mo PO this quarter. they still want the 12mo commercial term if possible. they asked for a one‑time invoice schedule to align with the PO.
jason_finance: we can accept a 9mo PO if we map it to the 12mo term via an addendum, but we need the vendor code and correct legal entity. also need to confirm payment method (ACH vs CC). any chance they can do a CC so we can avoid PO delays?
maria_cs: customer said CC is possible but they'd prefer PO. we should avoid blocking onboarding (they're mid-implementation). can we do an interim CC fallback with PO follow-up?

olivia_legal: prefer documented addendum: short doc that ties the PO to the 12mo term and includes the invoice schedule. i'll draft language. question: will price be prorated if invoice schedule differs? need clarity before i commit.
sam_ae: sales willing to hold price if we get a signature on the addendum + normal renewal SOW. we can offer a one-time onboarding credit instead of list discount. that's easier for procurement to approve.
maria_cs: plan proposal — Olivia drafts addendum, Jason confirms vendor code & invoicing path, Sam confirms concession (onboarding credit) and signs off, Bryan to get PO issued to entity X and share PO scan. Docusign route for addendum + SOW recommended to speed signature.
docusign-bot: DocuSign envelope created: Addendum (Cedarbridge) + Renewal SOW. Envelope ID: 0a1b2c3d. Recipients: bryan_cedarbridge (signer), sam_ae (cc), olivia_legal (cc). Link: https://docusign.example/envelope/0a1b2c3d
bryan_cedarbridge: receiving PO today. will sign addendum once i have the PO attached to our procurement system — can you add the PO # to the DocuSign envelope or do we need a new one?
maria_cs: you can drop PO # in the signing comments, but Olivia — do we need a new envelope to include the PO as an attachment?
olivia_legal: better to attach the PO to the envelope for record. maria: can you upload when you get the scan? i'll approve with that attachment.
jason_finance: vendor code is CB‑USA‑001. billing entity: Cedarbridge Holdings, Inc. send invoice to ap@cedarbridge.com. cc finance team on final envelope.
sam_ae: confirmed onboarding credit = $5k one-time. no change to ARR. maria, please capture in the addendum language: "one-time onboarding credit of $5,000 applied at invoice 1; no change to contract ARR or term."
maria_cs: noted and will add that to the DocuSign fields. also flagging onboarding team to pause any billable professional services until we confirm the PO hits the system.
bryan_cedarbridge: PO scanned and uploaded to DocuSign comments. PO#: 984320. signed and returned. thanks for moving fast. :thumbsup:

docusign-bot: Envelope 0a1b2c3d completed by bryan_cedarbridge at 2024-11-12T15:23:10Z. Documents: Addendum.pdf, Renewal_SOW.pdf, PO_984320.pdf
maria_cs: great — Olivia, can you confirm the addendum language is acceptable so we can push invoice?
olivia_legal: reviewed — language OK. one minor tweak to signature block, updated and re-sent. no further legal holds.
jason_finance: will generate invoice per agreed schedule. confirming: Invoice 1 includes onboarding credit (-$5000) then monthly invoices per ARR split. I will mark the account as billable in AR tomorrow.
sam_ae: thanks team. i'll update the opportunity to "renewed" and note the one-time credit. good save on churn risk.
maria_cs: closing loop — onboarding paused until billing flagged active; outreach to customer owner for kickoff once invoice paid. thanks everyone. :heart:
